##Run this code to read in all the files. After doing this once, you don't need to do it again. Just read in the seurat objects
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#Run this code to read in all the files. After doing this once, you don't need to do it again. Just read in the seurat objects

# get a list of all the .h5 files exported from CellRanger
files <- list.files("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/", recursive = TRUE, 
  full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  # ONLY include the "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5" files, 
  # ignore all others
  .[str_detect(., "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")]

# convert file names vector to a dataframe containing the full file names
# as well as the corresponding GEM and Sample name
files_df <- tibble(Files = files) %>% 
  mutate(GEM = str_extract(Files, "GEM.")) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = str_extract(Files, "MP-\\d\\d*"))
```
#Create a function to read in all 96 data files (24 samples plit across 4 gems)
```{r functions}
# THIS CHUNK INCLUDES FUNCTIONS TO READ IN THE RAW FILES 

# read in one h5 file, create a Seurat object, add metadata
# the function takes a single row of a data frame
#     the data frame should include the file name, the GEM, and the Sample
# add GEM and Sample to the meta.data of the resulting Seurat object
read_one_file <- function(files_df_row) {
  one_file <- Read10X_h5(files_df_row$Files) %>% CreateSeuratObject()
   #add metadata
  one_file$GEM <- files_df_row$GEM
  one_file$Sample <- files_df_row$Sample
  
  one_file
}

##BPCells is not compatible with MAST, which is required to determine DEG between clusters in the annotation process, so this way of reading in the raw files will not work

# use the BPCells package to put a Seurat object on disk to save memory
#put_on_disk <- function(obj) {
#  sample_id <- obj@meta.data$Sample[1]
#  
#  BPCells::write_matrix_dir(mat = obj[["RNA"]]$counts, dir = paste0('data/temp/', sample_id))
#  counts.mat <- BPCells::open_matrix_dir(dir = paste0('data/temp/', sample_id))
#  obj[["RNA"]]$counts <- counts.mat
  
#  obj  
#}

# read and combine all four GEM files for 1 sample
# Each sample is split across the 4 GEMs
# Given a sample name (e.g. "MP-1"), this function reads the 
# 4 h5 files for the sample (from each GEM) and combines them
# Then it puts the object on disk to save memory
read_one_sample <- function(sample) {
  # filter for the files just for one sample
  one_sample <- files_df %>% 
    filter(Sample == sample)
  
  # read in all 4 GEMs for one sample
  one_sample_list <- list(
    read_one_file(one_sample[1,]),
    read_one_file(one_sample[2,]),
    read_one_file(one_sample[3,]),
    read_one_file(one_sample[4,])
  )
  
  # merge together the four samples
  one_sample_merged <- merge(
                        # select first list element
                        one_sample_list[[1]],
                        # merge with every element except the first
                        one_sample_list[-1], 
                        add.cell.ids = c("GEM1", "GEM2", "GEM3", "GEM4") 
                       )

  
  # JoinLayers converts from one "counts layer" per GEM
  # to one per sample
  one_sample_merged %>% 
    JoinLayers() 
 #   put_on_disk()
}

# test code to make sure each function works
# sample_1 <- read_one_sample("MP-1")
# sample_2 <- read_one_sample("MP-2")
# test <- merge(sample_1, sample_2, add.cell.ids = c("MP-1", "MP-2"))
```
###Read in the raw files
```{r}
## THIS CHUNK READS IN THE RAW FILES AND MERGES THEM INTO A SEURAT OBJECT

# Read in every sample
# This results in a list of seurat objects (one per sample)
all_samples <- lapply(unique(files_df$Sample), read_one_sample)

# save list of seurat objects
write_rds(all_samples, "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/01-list_of_samples.rds")

```
###Merge the files into one seurat object
```{r}
# THIS CHUNK MERGES THE LIST OF SEURAT OBJECTS INTO A SINGLE OBJECT

# Combine list of seurat objects into a single Seurat object
all_merged <- merge(
                        # select first list element
                        all_samples[[1]],
                        # merge with every element except the first
                        all_samples[-1], 
                        add.cell.ids =  unique(files_df$Sample)
                        )
```
###Add meta bata (patient ID and menstrual cycle phase) to the object
```{r}
# THIS CHUNK ADDS METADATA (PTID AND PHASE) TO THE SAMPLES

# To add metadata with AddMetaData, you need a dataframe with rownames that match 
# the rownames from the SeuratObject 
# Steps:
# 1. Load metadata from file
metadata <- readxl::read_excel("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/PBMC-multilab plan for Innovation Lab_9feb26.xlsx", sheet = "Prlic") %>% 
    mutate(Phase = str_sub(`Sample ID`, 8, 8),
        Ptid = str_sub(`Sample ID`, 1, 7))

# 2. Select columns you want to add 
to_add <- metadata %>% 
    select(Sample = `Tube sample`, Ptid, Phase) %>% 
    as.data.frame()

# 3. Get the metadata out of the Seurat object because it has the rownames
old_meta_data <- all_merged@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(Rownames = rownames(.))

# 4. Merge the two metadata objects by sample. This associates all your new metadata
# with the appropriate cell identifiers in the rownames. Make sure to keep the rownames
# which tidyverse removes
new_meta_data <- merge(old_meta_data, to_add, by = "Sample")
rownames(new_meta_data) <- new_meta_data$Rownames
new_meta_data <- select(new_meta_data, -Rownames)

# 5. Add the new metadata to the Seurat Object
all_merged <- AddMetaData(all_merged, new_meta_data)

write_rds(all_merged, file = "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/02-merged.rds")
```

#Basic workflow: normalize, find variable features, scale data, run PCA, and cluster all the cells among the 20 samples

```{r}
# It can be useful to save the object after computational steps that take a long time as a precaution

# 1 Normalize data
#SCTransform didn't work and isn't compatible with MAST, so we're using NormalizeData
all_subset <- NormalizeData(all_subset, assay = "RNA", verbose = T)

# 2 Find Variable Features
all_subset <- FindVariableFeatures(all_subset, selection.method = "vst", verbose = T)

# 3 Scale Data
RNA_names <- rownames(all_subset)
all_subset <- ScaleData(all_subset, features = RNA_names)

# 4 Run PCA and check dimensionality of the data
all_subset <- RunPCA(all_subset, pc.genes = RNA_names, npcs = 75, verbose = T)
ElbowPlot(all_subset, ndims = 75)
ggsave("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/images/ElbowPlot.png", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 6)

# 5 Find nearest neighbors
all_subset <- FindNeighbors(all_subset, dims = 1:50)

# 6 Cluster with default resolution (0.8)
all_subset <- FindClusters(all_subset, resolution = 0.8)

# 7 Create UMAP
all_subset <- RunUMAP(all_subset, dims = 1:50, return.model = T)

#save seurat object
write_rds(all_subset, "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/06-DR-object.rds")

```

#####Heatmap to show DEGs between each cluster determined by MAST
```{r}
#Crahes unless you run downsampling
all_subset[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(all_subset[["RNA"]])

markers.all <- FindAllMarkers(all_subset,
                                only.pos = TRUE, 
                                logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                test.use = "MAST",
                                verbose = T,
                                latent.vars = "nCount_RNA",
                                max.cells.per.ident = 1000,
                                random.seed = 1)


write.xlsx(markers.all, file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation/all_cells_cluster_markers_res0.4.xlsx"))

top10 <- markers.all %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

color.vector <- c(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"), brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"), brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(subset(all_subset, downsample = 1000), 
                                   features = top10$gene, 
                                   group.bar = T,
                                   group.colors = color.vector,
                                   draw.lines = F,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   disp.min = -1.5, disp.max = 1.5,
                                   raster = F)

heatmap <- heatmap + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#440154FF", "#238A8DFF", "#FDE725FF")) 

ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation/all_cells_cluster_markers_res0.4.png"), plot = heatmap, dpi = 300, width = 24, height = 30)

```

##DE genes between F and L phases among Treg (cluster 10)

```{r}
Idents(Treg_subset) <-"Phase"
markers.all.Treg_subset <- FindMarkers(object = Treg_subset, 
                                                  ident.1 = "F", ident.2 = "L", 
                                                  min.pct = 0.1, 
                                                  features = genes.filtered,
                                                  test.use = "MAST", 
                                                  verbose = T,
                                                  latent.vars = "nCount_RNA") %>% rownames_to_column("gene")

write.xlsx(markers.all.Treg_subset, file = file.path( "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG/Treg_FvL_top_deg_MAST.xlsx"))

library(EnhancedVolcano)
rownames(markers.all.Treg_subset) <- markers.all.Treg_subset$gene

    markers.all.Treg_subset$avg_log2FC > 0.4 & markers.all.Treg_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'dodgerblue3',
```

#Subset T cells to make a new object 
```{r}
#Combine all the clusters that express CD3D and don't express CD14 or CD20 or NCAM1 and NKG7 
Tcell_subset <- subset(all_subset, idents = c("11", "7", "18", "3", "9", "6", "14", "6", "1", "27", "10", "0", "23"))

Tcell_subset <- FindVariableFeatures(Tcell_subset, selection.method = "vst", verbose = T)

RNA_names <- rownames(Tcell_subset)
Tcell_subset <- ScaleData(Tcell_subset, features = RNA_names)

Tcell_subset <- RunPCA(Tcell_subset, pc.genes = RNA_names, npcs = 75, verbose = T)
ElbowPlot(Tcell_subset, ndims = 75)
ggsave("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/images/ElbowPlot_Tcells.png", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 6)
write_rds(Tcell_subset, "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/07-Tcell-object.rds")

Tcell_subset <- FindNeighbors(Tcell_subset, dims = 1:40)
Tcell_subset <- FindClusters(Tcell_subset, resolution = 0.8)
Tcell_subset <- RunUMAP(Tcell_subset, dims = 1:40, return.model = T)

# save object
write_rds(Tcell_subset, "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/FL031_PBMC-Flex-v2/07-Tcell-object.rds")

DimPlot(Tcell_subset, label = T, label.size = 3, reduction = "umap")
ggsave("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/images/umap_Tcells.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 600)

```

###Heatmap to show DE genes between clusters of the T cell object
```{r}
#Crashes unless you run downsampling
Tcell_subset[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Tcell_subset[["RNA"]])

markers.T <- FindAllMarkers(Tcell_subset,
                                only.pos = TRUE, 
                                logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                test.use = "MAST",
                                verbose = T,
                                latent.vars = "nCount_RNA",
                                max.cells.per.ident = 1000,
                                random.seed = 1)


write.xlsx(markers.T, file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation.Tcells/Tcells_cluster_markers_res0.4.xlsx"))

top10 <- markers.all %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

color.vector <- c(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"), brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"), brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(subset(Tcell_subset, downsample = 1000), 
                                   features = top10$gene, 
                                   group.bar = T,
                                   group.colors = color.vector,
                                   draw.lines = F,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   disp.min = -1.5, disp.max = 1.5,
                                   raster = F)

heatmap <- heatmap + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#440154FF", "#238A8DFF", "#FDE725FF")) 

ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation.Tcells/Tcells_cluster_markers_res0.4.png"), plot = heatmap, dpi = 300, width = 24, height = 30)
```

#####Are any clusters differentially apparent by phase

```{r}
clusters  <- as.character((Tcell_subset$seurat_clusters)) # or seurat_obj$seurat_clusters
samples   <- as.character(Tcell_subset$orig.ident)
condition <- as.character(Tcell_subset$Phase)

# Create a raw count table
counts_matrix <- table(clusters, condition)

# Run Chi-Square test
chisq_test <- chisq.test(counts_matrix)
print(chisq_test)


	#Pearson's Chi-squared test

#data:  counts_matrix
#X-squared = 690.48, df = 11, p-value < 2.2e-16

#values > 2 or < -2 are significant
chisq_test$residuals

#clusters            F            L
#     0   -0.16047617   0.15586691
#      1    5.46617786  -5.30917633
#      10  -1.98536961   1.92834511
#      11   1.11588966  -1.08383868
#      2    8.18463270  -7.94955072
#      3  -15.32438014  14.88422775
#      4   -2.94897893   2.86427729
#      5   -0.09909148   0.09624534
#      6    0.06821566  -0.06625634
#      7    3.10878622  -3.01949454
#      8    0.03409879  -0.03311939
#      9   -0.06004799   0.05832327


# Convert residuals to two-tailed p-values
raw_p_values <- 2 * pnorm(abs(chisq_test$residuals), lower.tail = FALSE)

# Apply Bonferroni correction for your 11 variables
adjusted_p_values <- p.adjust(raw_p_values, method = "bonferroni")

# View the specific row matching your variable of interest
print(as.data.frame(adjusted_p_values))

```

####Remake Heatmap to show DE genes between clusters of the T cell object

```{r}
#Crashes unless you run downsampling
Tcell_subset[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Tcell_subset[["RNA"]])

markers.T <- FindAllMarkers(Tcell_subset,
                                only.pos = TRUE, 
                                logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                test.use = "MAST",
                                verbose = T,
                                latent.vars = "nCount_RNA",
                                max.cells.per.ident = 1000,
                                random.seed = 1)


write.xlsx(markers.T, file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation.Tcells/Tcells_cluster_markers_res0.4_filtered.xlsx"))

top10 <- markers.T %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

color.vector <- c(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"), brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"), brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(subset(Tcell_subset, downsample = 1000), 
                                   features = top10$gene, 
                                   group.bar = T,
                                   group.colors = color.vector,
                                   draw.lines = F,
                                   angle = 0,
                                   disp.min = -1.5, disp.max = 1.5,
                                   raster = F)

heatmap <- heatmap + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#440154FF", "#238A8DFF", "#FDE725FF")) 

ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/annotation.Tcells/Tcells_cluster_markers_res0.4_filtered.png"), plot = heatmap, dpi = 300, width = 24, height = 30)
```

###DE genes between F and L phases among gd T cells

```{r}
Idents(gd_subset) <-"Phase" 
markers.all.gd_subset <- FindMarkers(object = gd_subset, 
                                                  ident.1 = "F", ident.2 = "L", 
                                                  min.pct = 0.1, 
                                                  features = gd.genes.filtered,
                                                  test.use = "MAST", 
                                                  verbose = T,
                                                  latent.vars = "nCount_RNA") %>% rownames_to_column("gene")

write.xlsx(markers.all.gd_subset, file = file.path( "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/gdTcells_FvL_top_deg_MAST.xlsx"))

library(EnhancedVolcano)
rownames(markers.all.gd_subset) <- markers.all.gd_subset$gene

 keyvals <- ifelse(
    markers.all.gd_subset$avg_log2FC > 0.4 & markers.all.gd_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'dodgerblue3',
      ifelse(markers.all.gd_subset$avg_log2FC < -0.4 & markers.all.gd_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'firebrick',
        'grey30'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'grey30'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'dodgerblue3'] <- 'F'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'firebrick'] <- 'L'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'grey30'] <- 'NS'

  
gd.volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(markers.all.gd_subset,
                               lab = rownames(markers.all.gd_subset),
                               x = 'avg_log2FC',
                               y = 'p_val_adj',
                               labSize = 4,
                               pCutoff = 1e-2,
                               FCcutoff = 0.4,
                               pointSize = 2,
                               drawConnectors = TRUE,
                               title = "gd T cells F v L DEG",
                               subtitle = bquote(italic("avg_log2FC cutoff = 0.4, P value cutoff = 1e-2")),
                               colCustom = keyvals,
                               boxedLabels = TRUE,

                               colAlpha = 1,
                               legendPosition = 'bottom',
                               legendLabSize = 15,
                               legendIconSize = 5.0,
                               gridlines.major = T,
                               gridlines.minor = F)
gd.volcano
ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/gdTcells_FvL_volcano_colored.pdf"), 
       plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300, width = 14, height = 12)

VlnPlot(gd_subset, features = c("FKBP5", "PDE4D"),
        #idents = c(1,2),
        group.by = "Phase", 
        cols = c("firebrick", "dodgerblue3"), 
        pt.size = 0,
        y.max = NULL)

ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/gdTcell_FvL_violin_colored.png"), plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 10)
```

```{r}
cd8B_subset <- subset(Tcell_subset, idents = c("4"))

cd8B_subset[["RNA"]] <- as(cd8B_subset[["RNA"]], "Assay")

# Filter out mitochondrial genes for DEG analysis
genes <- rownames(cd8B_subset@assays$RNA@counts)
genes.filtered.mt <- grep(pattern = "^MT-", genes, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)
genes.filtered <- as.vector(grep(pattern = "^RP", genes.filtered.mt, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE))
length(genes)
# [1] 18133
length(genes.filtered)
# [1] 18079


```

###DE genes between F and L phases among CD8 GzmB+ cells
```{r}
Idents(cd8B_subset) <-"Phase" 
markers.all.cd8B_subset <- FindMarkers(object = cd8B_subset, 
                                                  ident.1 = "F", ident.2 = "L", 
                                                  min.pct = 0.1, 
                                                  features = genes.filtered,
                                                  test.use = "MAST", 
                                                  verbose = T,
                                                  latent.vars = "nCount_RNA") %>% rownames_to_column("gene")

write.xlsx(markers.all.cd8B_subset, file = file.path( "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/CD8GzmB_FvL_top_deg_MAST.xlsx"))

library(EnhancedVolcano)
rownames(markers.all.cd8B_subset) <- markers.all.cd8B_subset$gene

 keyvals <- ifelse(
    markers.all.cd8B_subset$avg_log2FC > 0.4 & markers.all.cd8B_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'dodgerblue3',
      ifelse(markers.all.cd8B_subset$avg_log2FC < -0.4 & markers.all.cd8B_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'firebrick',
        'grey30'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'grey30'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'dodgerblue3'] <- 'F'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'firebrick'] <- 'L'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'grey30'] <- 'NS'

  
treg.volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(markers.all.cd8B_subset,
                               lab = rownames(markers.all.cd8B_subset),
                               x = 'avg_log2FC',
                               y = 'p_val_adj',
                               labSize = 4,
                               pCutoff = 1e-2,
                               FCcutoff = 0.4,
                               pointSize = 2,
                               drawConnectors = TRUE,
                               title = "GzmB+ CD8 T cells F v L DEG",
                               subtitle = bquote(italic("avg_log2FC cutoff = 0.4, P value cutoff = 1e-2")),
                               colCustom = keyvals,
                               boxedLabels = TRUE,

                               colAlpha = 1,
                               legendPosition = 'bottom',
                               legendLabSize = 15,
                               legendIconSize = 5.0,
                               gridlines.major = T,
                               gridlines.minor = F)
treg.volcano
ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/CD8GzmB_FvL_volcano_colored.pdf"), 
       plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300, width = 14, height = 12)

VlnPlot(cd8B_subset, features = c("LYZ", "S100A8", "FKBP5" ),
        #idents = c(1,2),
        group.by = "Phase", 
        cols = c("firebrick", "dodgerblue3"), 
        pt.size = 0,
        y.max = NULL)

ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/DEG.T/CD8GzmB_FvL_violin_colored.png"), plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 10)
```

```{r}

library(EnhancedVolcano)
```

```{r}
genes.filtered <- as.vector(grep(pattern = "^RP", genes.filtered.mt, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE))
length(genes)
# [1] 18133
length(genes.filtered)
# [1] 18079

Idents(PGRMC2_subset) <-"Phase" 
markers.all.PGRMC2_subset <- FindMarkers(object = PGRMC2_subset, 
                                                  ident.1 = "F", ident.2 = "L", 
                                                  min.pct = 0.1, 
                                                  features = genes.filtered,
                                                  test.use = "MAST", 
                                                  verbose = T,
                                                  latent.vars = "nCount_RNA") %>% rownames_to_column("gene")

write.xlsx(markers.all.PGRMC2_subset, file = file.path( "/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/Tcells.mPGR/CD8_TeffGzmK_PGRMC2_FvL_top_deg_MAST.xlsx"))

library(EnhancedVolcano)
rownames(markers.all.PGRMC2_subset) <- markers.all.PGRMC2_subset$gene

 keyvals <- ifelse(
    markers.all.PGRMC2_subset$avg_log2FC > 0.4 & markers.all.PGRMC2_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'dodgerblue3',
      ifelse(markers.all.PGRMC2_subset$avg_log2FC < -0.4 & markers.all.PGRMC2_subset$p_val_adj < 1e-2, 'firebrick',
        'grey30'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'grey30'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'dodgerblue3'] <- 'F'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'firebrick'] <- 'L'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'grey30'] <- 'NS'

  
volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(markers.all.PGRMC2_subset,
                               lab = rownames(markers.all.PGRMC2_subset),
                               x = 'avg_log2FC',
                               y = 'p_val_adj',
                               labSize = 4,
                               pCutoff = 1e-2,
                               FCcutoff = 0.4,
                               pointSize = 2,
                               drawConnectors = TRUE,
                               title = "PGRMC2+ CD8 Effector Memory GzmK+ cells F v L DEG",
                               subtitle = bquote(italic("avg_log2FC cutoff = 0.4, P value cutoff = 1e-2")),
                               colCustom = keyvals,
                               boxedLabels = TRUE,

                               colAlpha = 1,
                               legendPosition = 'bottom',
                               legendLabSize = 15,
                               legendIconSize = 5.0,
                               gridlines.major = T,
                               gridlines.minor = F)
volcano
ggsave(filename = file.path("/home/qpeters/scRNAseq/P4_PBMC_FLEX/Tcells.mPGR/CD8_TeffGzmK_PGRMC2_FvL_top_deg_MAST.pdf"),
```

```{r}
clusters  <- as.character((Tcell_subset$seurat_clusters)) # or seurat_obj$seurat_clusters
samples   <- as.character(Tcell_subset$orig.ident)
condition <- as.character(Tcell_subset$Phase)

# Create a raw count table
counts_matrix <- table(clusters, condition)

# Run Chi-Square test
chisq_test <- chisq.test(counts_matrix)
print(chisq_test)

#values > 2 or < -2 are significant
chisq_test$residuals


#clusters            F            L
#     0   -0.16047617   0.15586691
#      1    5.46617786  -5.30917633
#      10  -1.98536961   1.92834511

#      8    0.03409879  -0.03311939
```
